hooks.name: aidlc-test-pro-compose
hooks.description: Composes the test-pro AIDLC plugin on first interaction.

action.command: sh -c 'AIDLC=$(command -v aidlc 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$AIDLC" ] && { AIDLC_HARNESS_DIR=.kiro AIDLC_HARNESS_NAME=kiro-unified "$AIDLC" plugin sync && exit 0; }; BUN=$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null || true); [ -z "$BUN" ] && [ -x "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" ] && BUN="$HOME/.bun/bin/bun"; [ -z "$BUN" ] && { echo "aidlc plugin compose: aidlc and bun not found, skipping" >&2; exit 0; }; AIDLC_HARNESS_DIR=.kiro AIDLC_HARNESS_NAME=kiro-unified "$BUN" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/compose.ts"'
